Python Learners: how to ask good questions

This is a friendly place for people learning Python. Read this before posting.

  1. Be patient with beginners; everyone started somewhere.
  2. Do not promote your courses, books or YouTube channel here.
  3. Questions only, please, and post at most 3 questions per week so helpers are not overwhelmed.
  4. Post code as text inside a code block, not as screenshots.

Thank you for helping keep this space useful.
